description: history_card/2 in Checkpointed Local Log form: the positions P(n, W), and whether a card verifies or the first check it fails.

notes.inputs: Each case gives a card (the result map of §8.1.2), the anchor the response resolved (SHA-256 of the anchor checkpoint's octets, 64 lowercase hex) and the log keys the requester accepts for the stream (log_keys at the top of the file).
notes.result: expect.valid is true when every check of §8.1.2 'Verifying' passes. Otherwise expect.finding is the first check that fails, in the order of HC2_FINDINGS: card_malformed (the result or an entry is not the maps and types of §8.1.2), then checks 1 to 7. These finding names are fixed for these vectors only.
notes.checks: card_malformed: the card is not a map; window is not an unsigned integer; history is not a list; an entry is not a map with position (unsigned integer), checkpoint (hex text), receipts (a list) and consistency_from_previous (hex text or null). Members a profile adds are ignored. 1 window_out_of_range: window outside 1..64. 2 positions_not_increasing_from_zero: history is empty, the first position is not 0, or the positions do not strictly increase. 3 position_missing / position_unexpected: with n the last position, a position of P(n, window) is not listed (missing is checked first) or a listed position is not in P(n, window). 4 checkpoint_invalid: a checkpoint is not a well-formed cll-checkpoint (interop profile §6.2.1 step 7), its kid is not in log_keys, or its COSE_Sign1 signature does not verify; first_checkpoint_has_predecessor: the checkpoint at position 0 has a prev_size other than 0; checkpoint_shrinks: its log_size is smaller than the previous entry's. Entries are checked in order, each fully, before the next. 5 proof_invalid: the first entry carries a proof, a later entry carries none, the proof is not cll-consistency-proof octets whose tree sizes are the two checkpoints' log_size values, or it does not prove the entry's commitment extends the previous entry's (MMR -02 §7.1). 6 receipt_invalid: a receipt is not {checkpoint, witness, sig}, its checkpoint is not SHA-256 of its own entry's checkpoint octets, or sig is not an Ed25519 signature by witness over UTF-8 of JCS of {checkpoint, witness}. 7 anchor_mismatch: SHA-256 of the last checkpoint's octets is not the anchor.
notes.log_size: log_size counts MMR nodes, as the consistency proofs' tree sizes do and as known implementations write it (interop profile v1 open point on the unit of log_size).
notes.receipts: The receipt form {checkpoint, witness, sig} is fixed for these vectors only and is not registered; -03 leaves receipt encodings to the evidence mechanism. Which witnesses count is requester policy; these vectors only check that each receipt covers its checkpoint.

cases.description: A card over 1100 checkpoints (anchor position 1099), window 8: 17 entries.
A stream of one checkpoint: the card lists position 0 only.
Window 64 over a stream of six checkpoints: every position is listed.
Window 64, the cap, over 1100 checkpoints.
Entries with no receipts verify: receipts may be empty.
Members a deployment profile adds to the result are ignored.
The result is a list, not a map.
An entry without receipts.
A position given as text.
Window 0 is outside 1 to 64.
Window 65 is over the cap, even with the positions P(n, 65) gives.
No entries.
The card starts at position 1, not 0.
A position listed twice.
The sample at position 587 (512 back from the anchor) is left out; the proofs still chain.
Position 1096 inside the window is left out; the proofs still chain.
Position 500, not in P(n, W), is listed; the proofs still chain.
The positions are P(n, 8) but the card states window 4.
One checkpoint is signed by a log key the requester does not accept.
One checkpoint's COSE_Sign1 signature does not verify.
One checkpoint is not a cll-checkpoint statement.
The entry at position 1067 carries the checkpoint of position 971, which covers fewer entries than the one before it.
The proof into position 1035 is a valid proof from position 843, not from 971, the entry before it.
One proof's last peak has a flipped bit.
A later entry carries no proof.
The first entry carries a proof.
A receipt covers another entry's checkpoint.
A receipt's signature does not verify.
A checkpoint's hex text with two leading spaces.
A checkpoint's hex text in upper case.
A one-entry card whose position 0 carries the checkpoint of stream position 5, which commits to an earlier checkpoint (prev_size not 0).
The first checkpoint's issued_at in lower-case t and z, an RFC 3339 form.
The first checkpoint's issued_at with a numeric offset.
The first checkpoint's issued_at names 30 February.
The first checkpoint's claims carry one more member, x, whose value is the half-precision float 1.5 (f9 3e 00), signed: outside the profile's data model, so not a well-formed cll-checkpoint.
The first checkpoint's tag 18 written in two octets (d8 12), not one: still a well-formed cll-checkpoint, whose signature covers only the protected header and payload.
The card ends at position 1099, but the response resolved the checkpoint at position 1098.
